purpose: Distinguish expected on-demand sleep staleness from stale on-demand services that require explicit revalidation, without changing raw estate, health, incident or release-admission truth.

states.meaning: The target is not configured as an on-demand sleep-aware Railway service.
The target is intentionally sleeping, canonical deployment identity is unchanged, prior on-demand proof remains reusable, source identity/authority are current, and source head has not moved ahead.
The target is sleep-aware/on-demand but source, deployment, authority, transition or prior-proof evidence no longer permits benign stale attribution.

invariants: This contract never changes the release-admission decision or raw estate state.
A stale serving proof is never excused when the source head is ahead of the canonical serving commit.
A changed deployment identity never reuses prior on-demand proof.
A stale or mismatched source authority never qualifies as expected sleep.
Failed/crashed transition evidence never qualifies as expected sleep.
No automatic wake, deploy, retry, rollback, probe or evidence rewrite is authorised.
Browser roles receive no EXECUTE grant.
